text:
maria_docs: Quick question  adding a short docs blurb for EU/Nordic availability. We need tiny curl + Go SDK examples showing the request header and how to detect fallbacks in response headers. Also want a one-line legal caveat. Anyone volunteer to draft?

oleg_go: I can draft the Go snippet. Do we want to standardize on `X-Region` header in examples?

sam_platform: Yes, `X-Region` is fine. Note in the copy that the system normalizes headers to lowercase (`x-region`) and returns `x-region-routed` when routing differs. We also surface routing decisions in the Console under Request logs.

oleg_go: Draft below — posting before I open a PR. Keeping it minimal for copy + paste.

oleg_go: ```bash
# curl example
curl -sS https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Region: nordic" -d '{"model":"redwood-1-mini","prompt":"Ping from Nordic region"}'
```

oleg_go: ```go
// Go SDK illustrative example
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
req := redwood.GenerateRequest{ Model: "redwood-1-mini", Prompt: "Ping from Nordic region" }
res, err := client.Generate(req, redwood.WithHeader("X-Region", "nordic"))
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
if got := res.Headers.Get("x-region-routed"); got != "nordic" && got != "" {
  log.Printf("Routed to %s (requested nordic)", got)
}
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```

emma_legal: Short suggested legal line: "Requests targeted to Nordic endpoints are routed within EU/EEA boundaries where feasible; please refer to your contract for binding residency terms." Keep it succinct and non-binding.

maria_docs: Good. Add one extra sentence about capacity/fallbacks: "If regional availability is constrained, requests may be routed to compatible EU locations; the Console and response headers indicate that routing."

sam_platform: Confirmed: we emit `x-region-routed` with the final region value when routing differs. Values are lowercase. We'll also add a telemetry flag next sprint to surface this in audit logs (no docs change now).

oleg_go: I'll include a tiny test-case suggestion for QA in the PR so docs reviewers can validate header behavior: `curl ... -H 'X-Region: nordic' ; check response headers for x-region-routed`

qa-bot: Reminder: include an example asserting header presence in the docs tests to avoid regressions.

maria_docs: Minor copy edit: use US English, prefer "Nordic" capitalized only in prose, but header value stays lowercase (`nordic`). Also change "endpoints" -> "region" in the legal sentence.

emma_legal: OK: updated wording suggestion: "Requests targeted to the Nordic region are routed within EU/EEA boundaries where feasible; refer to your contract for definitive residency guarantees."

oleg_go: Pushed branch and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1740 (curl + Go snippet + legal note + QA checklist).

docs-bot: docs CI started for PR #1740 (netlify preview queued)

maria_docs: Quick final pass for style and then merge. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:

docs-bot: docs CI: preview build success for PR #1740 ✅

maria_docs: Merged to staging and preview site. Leaving a short TODO in the PR to follow up when telemetry flag lands. Closing thread.
